description_for_human: Generative-UI streamboards. Your LLM writes the spec; you push the data. Every push is a new versioned URL.
description_for_model: You are interacting with the streamboard API, a hosted MCP server for authoring and versioning generative-UI streamboards. A streamboard is a json-render spec (KPI tiles, charts, tables) stored against an immutable (id, version) pair and served at a permanent URL. Use create_streamboard to author a new spec, update_streamboard to patch an existing one (each update mints a new version), get_streamboard to read the current spec, and list_versions to walk history. Specs leave `{ $bind: "path" }` slots where live values go; users push fresh data into those slots over the data API with a per-streamboard bearer token. Streamboards can be public (shareable URL) or private (org-scoped).
